headline: A problem report can now show the problem
highlights: The problem-report dialog can now attach screenshots — up to three images, downscaled before they travel, for the problems words can't carry: a broken layout, a wrong colour, a control out of place.

⌘Q asks before losing work: if a batch is still running — a transcription run, a package build — the quit pauses on one plain question instead of silently abandoning it. With nothing at risk it just quits; review decisions, edits, comments, and flags are already saved the moment they happen.
